header.title:
A small island.
An obsessive standard.
header.sub: MPM is a family-run house of chauffeurs, captains and concierges. We have lived on Mykonos all our lives, and we treat every guest as the only guest of the season.

story.title:
Eight summers,
one quiet promise.
story.p1: MPM Mykonos Precious Moments is a luxury transportation company specialising in high-end, professional and discreet chauffeur services for an esteemed clientele. With an established presence on the island and an expert understanding of its landscapes and locations, we deliver unparalleled transport solutions to elevate every Mykonos experience.
story.p2: Our mission is simple — to offer exceptional service and create unforgettable journeys. Every itinerary is personalised, with strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, attention to detail and a thorough understanding of each guest's unique needs. From the picturesque streets of Mykonos Town and the vibrant nightlife of Paradise Beach, to the tranquil beauty of Fokos, Psarrou, Platis Gialos and Paraga — we cater to your every wish.
story.p3: One-way rides, full-day service, or a chauffeur by the hour, day or week — we make your travel seamless. And beyond land, we orchestrate private jet and helicopter transfers on arrival and departure, alongside sea taxis, speedboats and yacht charters tailored to a uniquely carefree vacation on the captivating island of Mykonos.

principles.title:
Six house rules,
kept religiously.
principles.lead: These aren't policies for a brochure. They are the things we audit at the end of each season — and the reason guests return for theirs.

items.title: On time, always early
items.body: Chauffeurs arrive fifteen minutes before pickup. We track flights, ferries, and yacht ETAs in real time.

items.title: Confidentiality, by contract
items.body: Every chauffeur signs an NDA. No photographs, no social media, no chatter at the bar.

items.title: Brand-new fleet
items.body: Vehicles are retired at 24 months of service or 60,000 kilometres — whichever comes first.

items.title: One concierge per guest
items.body: You speak to a single person for the length of your stay. The phone is answered, day or night.

items.title: Local knowledge, not Google
items.body: Our chauffeurs are island-born. They know the chef at Nammos, the marina manager at Tourlos, and the quiet way to Elia.

items.title: Special requests, no surcharge
items.body: Child seats fitted on request. Rear row removed for additional luggage space. All courtesy of the house — just tell us in advance.

pillars.title:
Three things we are
known for.
pillars.lead: A reputation built on consistently delivering top-tier transport, superior service, and an unwavering commitment to your satisfaction.

items.title:
Island-born chauffeurs,
not just drivers.
items.body: Our drivers are more than chauffeurs — they are local experts with years inside Mykonos luxury transport. They know the traffic patterns, the back roads, and the right person to call at every door. With MPM, you do not get a ride; you get a service that turns the visit into a collection of precious moments.

items.title:
Book us at any hour,
to any destination.
items.body: Whether you need a one-time transfer or the fleet and chauffeurs at your disposal for a full day, we are available whenever you need us. Plan your route ahead, or decide on the spot — our mission is a seamless, stress-free experience in Mykonos. More than a transport service, your reliable travel partner on the island.

items.title:
Travel the island in the
way it deserves.
items.body: Explore the high-end places of Mykonos in a fleet of luxurious Mercedes-Benz vehicles, fitted with every amenity a top-tier service should offer. From world-renowned beach clubs and five-star restaurants to the island's hidden gems, our chauffeurs make every journey as exceptional as the destination.

ports.lead: Where every Mykonos holiday begins and ends. Tracked flights, ferry schedules, and yacht ETAs in real time.

items.title: JMK · Mykonos Airport
items.body: Meet & greet inside the terminal. Flight tracking. Chauffeur waiting before you reach baggage claim.

items.title: Old Port · Chora
items.body: Yacht tenders, Delos boats, small ferries. Pickup right at the harbour quay or the steps at Gialos.

items.title: New Port · Tourlos
items.body: High-speed ferries from Rafina & Piraeus, large yachts, and most cruise ship tenders.

beaches.title: South coast & beach.
beaches.lead: The clubs you've heard about, and the quieter ones you'll discover. Drop-offs to the door, wait time included on disposal bookings.

items.title: Nammos · Psarrou
items.body: Mykonos' most famous beach club, four kilometres from Chora. Lunch service, daybeds, the long lunch.

items.title: Scorpios · Paraga
items.body: Sunset rituals on the southern tip. We know the late-night pickup spot the valets don't tell you about.

items.title: Super Paradise
items.body: The party beach of the south coast. Day beds at Jackie O', dancing on tables by sundown.

items.title: Platis Gialos · Ornos
items.body: Family-friendly bays, taverna lunches with toes in sand. Our most-requested kid-safe stretch.

items.title: Kalo Livadi · Elia
items.body: East coast, long crescent beach. Quieter sand at the south end, Spilia for cliff-side lunch.

items.title: Agios Sostis · Panormos
items.body: Unspoiled north-coast bay. No beach bar, no umbrellas — bring a towel and a chauffeur who waits.

landmarks.title: Mykonos Town.
landmarks.lead: The white-cubed centre of the island. We drop at the closest accessible point — Town is largely pedestrian — and pick up wherever you like.

items.title: Chora · Little Venice
items.body: The heart of Mykonos. Drop at Mavrogenous Square or the wind-mills, depending on where you're going.

items.title: Faros Armenistis
items.body: The lighthouse on the north-west tip. Famous sunset, almost empty between 6 and 7 PM.

items.title: Delos · Rinia
items.body: UNESCO archaeological island, 30 minutes by boat. We coordinate ferry timings or charter your own.

villas.title: Where you stay.
villas.lead: We are the preferred chauffeur partner for several of the island's best hotels and most-loved private villas. Direct gate access, valet hand-off, name on every guest list.

what.title:
Four ways to leave
the island, by air.
what.lead: From a 45-minute hop to Athens to a same-day return from a meeting in Rome — every mission is built around your schedule, not an airline timetable.

tiles.title: Helicopter to Athens
tiles.body: Forty-five minutes door to door, JMK to the Athens Riviera or the international airport. A chauffeur on each end, baggage handled, no terminal queues.

tiles.title: Private jet charter
tiles.body: From JMK to Nice, Geneva, London, Rome or further. Light jets for couples, mid-size for families, heavy jets for groups — selected per passenger count, luggage and range.

tiles.title: Island hopping by air
tiles.body: Same-morning hops to Santorini for lunch, Crete for an afternoon, Athens for a meeting and back by dinner. The Cyclades, from above and on schedule.

tiles.title: Aerial island tours
tiles.body: Thirty-minute scenic helicopter flights over Mykonos, Delos, Rinia and the south coast. A photographer's view of the island, with champagne on landing.

row2.title: FBO. Customs. Car. Drink, on landing.
row2.p1: An air transfer with MPM is not just a flight. It is a chauffeur at the villa, a porter for the bags, an FBO lounge if you need it, customs and immigration handled where applicable, and a chilled drink in the car the moment you step off.
row2.p2: For inbound guests, the inverse — your private jet lands at JMK, your chauffeur is waiting at the apron, and your bags are at the villa before you finish the welcome aperitif.

header.title:

intro.title:
Luggage Storage
& Transfer Services.
intro.lead: Villa check-out is at 11. Your flight is at 9. The day in between belongs to you — not to two suitcases following you around. MPM's luggage logistics service stores, transports and delivers your bags across Mykonos so you can spend the gap exactly where you want to.

row1.title: Climate-controlled storage in the heart of Mykonos Town.
row1.body: Our luggage facility sits a short walk from the Old Port — climate-controlled, monitored, and accessible to our team only. Each bag is photographed and tagged on arrival, stored on individual racks, and handed off through a chain-of-custody log that runs all the way to the airline check-in counter at JMK.

bullets: Climate-controlled storage in Mykonos Town
Pickup & drop-off island-wide · JMK airport, ports, hotels, villas, yachts
Hand-off direct to airline check-in at JMK
Bags tagged, weighed, photographed and tracked
Same-day service · multi-day storage at flat daily rate
From €25 per bag · group rates on request

use.title:
Four ways guests
actually use it.
use.lead: The luggage service exists for the awkward gap between check-out and check-in, between the villa and the yacht, between the last beach and the late flight home.

tiles.title: After villa check-out
tiles.body: Check out of your villa at 11am, fly out at 9pm. We collect your bags, store them in climate-controlled lockers in town, and meet you at JMK before your gate opens.

tiles.title: Before you board
tiles.body: Bags waiting at the yacht when you arrive, not at the hotel. Drop with our concierge in the morning, find them in the tender by lunchtime.

tiles.title: Day trip storage
tiles.body: Crossing to Delos, lunch at Nammos, sunset at Scorpios — and a flight to catch at 11pm. We hold your bags for the day, and bring them to the airport on the dot.

tiles.title: Tracked & insured
tiles.body: Every bag is photographed at pickup, weighed, tagged with a unique code, and tracked from collection to hand-off. Fully insured, GDPR compliant.

row2.title: Hand-off at JMK, before your gate opens.
row2.p1: For departures, we deliver your bags directly to the airline check-in counter at JMK Mykonos airport, timed to the opening of your flight. Our team handles the queue, the documentation, and the boarding-pass exchange — so you arrive at the airport with hand luggage only, no need to carry, push or drag a thing.
row2.p2: For arrivals, the inverse — bags are collected from JMK and waiting at your villa, hotel or yacht before you finish your first drink on the island.

what.title:
True luxury,
on your schedule.
what.lead: Why settle for less when you can indulge in the ultimate luxury experience with MPM's on disposal driver service? Our professional drivers and high-end vehicles cater to your every whim — convenience, confidentiality and luxury, in a single booking.

tiles.title: By the hour or by the week
tiles.body: Three hours for a long lunch, twelve for a wedding day, seven days for a whole holiday. Quoted upfront, no surprise add-ons.

tiles.title: Confidential by contract
tiles.body: Every chauffeur signs an NDA. No photographs, no social media, no chatter at the bar. We have hosted celebrity and corporate clientele since 2018.

tiles.title: Local knowledge on tap
tiles.body: Need a quiet cove, a late dinner that is not booked out, or a florist that delivers at 2am? Your driver knows the door, and the doorman.

tiles.title: One car, one driver, all day
tiles.body: The same vehicle and the same person from morning swim to last drink. No call-outs, no waiting, no second taxi.

cta.title: Tell us when, and for how long.

header.title:
Fixed fares.
Tracked arrivals.
header.sub: Punctual, point-to-point transfers in high-end Mercedes-Benz vehicles — between JMK, the ports, your villa, and every beach club in between.

intro.title:
Per Route Transfers
in Mykonos.
intro.lead: For guests who know exactly where they are going and want it done flawlessly, MPM's per-route transfer service offers fixed-fare, point-to-point chauffeured journeys across the island. Every route is priced upfront, every fare is all-inclusive, and every chauffeur is briefed before you ever land.

row1.title: Mercedes-Benz comfort, island-born chauffeurs.
row1.body: Our fleet of Mercedes-Benz V-Class, S-Class and Sprinter vehicles is reserved exclusively for transfer guests — air-conditioned, Wi-Fi enabled, stocked with bottled water and detailed daily. Every chauffeur is island-born, multilingual, and licensed by the Greek E.O.T. as a transfer operator. They know the back roads to your villa, the rush at Ornos, and the quietest route across town when Chora is closed for the procession.

bullets: JMK Airport ↔ any villa, hotel or port across Mykonos
Old Port ↔ New Port (Tourlos) ↔ Rafina · Piraeus ferries
Beach club & restaurant round-trips with included wait time
Meet & greet at arrivals · name board · luggage handled door to door
Tracked flights, ferries and yacht ETAs — chauffeur waiting before you arrive
From €120 per route, all-in · no hidden fees

routes.title:
Every point on the
island, covered.
routes.lead: Whether it's the airport at sunrise, the ferry at midnight, or the dinner reservation that runs long — we handle the route, the timing, and everything in between.

tiles.title: Mykonos Airport transfers
tiles.body: From the moment your flight lands, your chauffeur is already waiting at arrivals with your name on a discreet board. Bags handled, drinks chilled, and the most scenic route home, if you wish it.

tiles.title: Port & ferry transfers
tiles.body: From the New Port at Tourlos to a villa in Agios Lazaros, or the Old Port at Chora to your yacht's tender — we shadow the ferry schedules and the marina manifest, so you never wait on a dock.

tiles.title: Round-trip transfers
tiles.body: Drop at Nammos for lunch, collect at sundown. Drop at Scorpios at 9, collect at 3am. Wait time, parking, and the long way home are all included in one fixed fare.

tiles.title: Inter-villa & private events
tiles.body: Wedding parties, multi-villa dinners, and the after-party. Multiple vehicles in convoy, coordinated by a single concierge on the phone.

row2.title: All-inclusive pricing. Tracked flights. Real concierges.
row2.p1: Every per-route fare includes meet & greet, luggage handling, wait time on delayed flights and ferries, bottled water, Wi-Fi, and child seats on request. There is no surge pricing, no after-hours premium, and no charge for waiting on a delayed yacht tender. If your itinerary changes en route — we adjust, you do not pay twice.
row2.p2: A single concierge handles your booking from the first email to the last drop-off. Reachable 24 hours a day, in English, Greek, French and Italian.

cta.title: Quote a route in under a minute.

header.title:
One chauffeur.
The whole stay.
header.sub: A dedicated driver and a dedicated Mercedes for the length of your holiday. Your fixer, your local, your discreet ride across the island — 24 hours a day.

intro.title:
Hire a Private Chauffeur
in Mykonos.
intro.lead: A private chauffeur from MPM Mykonos Precious Moments is not a driver you call from a stand. They are the same person at the wheel from the moment your flight lands to the moment your holiday ends — briefed on your itinerary, fluent in your language, and on call at any hour. They will know your morning swim, your dinner reservation at Hippie Fish, and that you take the long way home.

row1.title: A fixer behind the wheel, available around the clock.
row1.body: Our VIP chauffeurs are island-born, professionally trained and certified by the Greek E.O.T. as licensed transfer operators. They are multilingual, NDA-signed, and used to handling diplomatic, celebrity and yacht clientele. Beyond driving, they are your fixer on the island — booking the unbookable table, calling ahead to the beach club, picking up the prescription before you finish lunch.

bullets: Dedicated driver and dedicated vehicle for the length of your stay
Mercedes-Benz V-Class or S-Class as standard · Maybach, EQS or G-Class on request
Unlimited radius across Mykonos · 24-hour availability
NDA-signed · multilingual (English, Greek, French, Italian)
Island-born — knows the chef at Nammos, the harbour master at Tourlos
From €1,400 / day · multi-day rates on request

why.title:
Four reasons our
guests return.
why.lead: A private chauffeur is more than transportation — it is a single, trusted point of contact who can resolve almost anything that comes up across a week on the island.

tiles.title: One face, all week
tiles.body: The same chauffeur from the moment you land to the last drop-off at JMK. They learn your rhythms, your reservations, and which beach you prefer in the morning.

tiles.title: 24 hours, no exceptions
tiles.body: Late dinners, early flights, midnight runs to the pharmacy. The phone is answered at every hour — and the car arrives within fifteen minutes.

tiles.title: NDA-signed, every driver
tiles.body: Confidentiality is in the contract, not the brochure. No social media, no photographs, no chatter at the bar.

tiles.title: Island knowledge, not Google
tiles.body: Our drivers grew up here. They know the chef at Hippie Fish, the door at Scorpios, and the right hour to cross Chora.

row2.eyebrowSm: The car, and the man at the wheel
row2.title: Brand-new Mercedes-Benz. Driver fitted to the guest.
row2.p1: Each chauffeur drives a Mercedes-Benz V-Class or S-Class as standard, with EQS, Maybach S 680 or G-Class available on request. The fleet is replaced every 24 months, detailed daily, and stocked with bottled water, 4G Wi-Fi and a low-volume playlist.
row2.p2: Tell our concierge how you prefer to travel — quiet or conversational, with the windows down or the air on, taking the scenic route or the fastest one home — and we pair you with the chauffeur who fits.

header.title:
From the dock.
Around the Cyclades.
header.sub: Private sea transfers, day charters and sunset cruises from Mykonos — to Delos, Rinia, the small Cyclades and beyond. Full crew, private chef on request.

intro.title:
Mykonos Sea Transfers
& Luxury Yacht Tours.
intro.lead: A fifteen-minute crossing to Delos, a slow afternoon at the small Cyclades, or a multi-day route to Santorini — MPM orchestrates the boat, the crew, the provisioning and the land logistics on both ends. Charter from the Old Port, the New Port, or wherever your yacht is anchored.

row1.title: A boat fitted for the day, a crew fitted to the guest.
row1.body: Our day-charter fleet is led by a Sunseeker 76 — ten guests, four cabins, three crew, fully insured for Greek and international waters. Onboard: shaded sun deck, dining for ten, a master cabin for changing, a tender for beach landings, and a fridge stocked to your preferences before you board.

bullets: Day charters: Delos · Rinia · Tinos · the small Cyclades
Sunset cruises with private chef & sommelier on request
Yacht meets at the Old Port, Tourlos, or your villa's anchor
Captain, deckhand, fuel & refreshments included
From €1,800 / half-day · custom multi-day on request
Land-to-sea handover — chauffeur to tender, in a single booking

routes.title:
Where the boat
actually goes.
routes.lead: Half-day, full-day and multi-day routes our captains know like the back of their hand. Every itinerary is customisable — swim stops, lunch venues, anchorages.

tiles.title: Delos & Rinia
tiles.body: Half-day charter to the sacred island of Delos and its quieter sister Rinia. UNESCO ruins, swim stops in turquoise coves, lunch at anchor. Half-day from €1,800.

tiles.title: Sunset cruise
tiles.body: Out at golden hour, around the south coast, anchor for sunset off Paranga or Agrari. Private chef on board, sommelier on request, back to port by 11. From €2,400.

tiles.title: Small Cyclades day trip
tiles.body: A full day across to Schinoussa, Koufonisia and Iraklia — three island stops, three lunch options, one quiet boat home.

tiles.title: Multi-day Cyclades
tiles.body: Tinos, Paros, Naxos, Antiparos and Santorini in two to five nights. Cabins, crew, route planning, ports and provisioning — all orchestrated by your concierge.

row2.title: Chauffeur to the dock. Tender to the boat. No friction.
row2.p1: Every sea booking is paired with a chauffeured transfer from your villa or hotel to the boarding point — the Old Port, the New Port at Tourlos, or a private anchorage with tender. Refreshments are stocked on board to your preferences, chefs and sommeliers arranged through our partners, and a return transfer waiting on the dock when you step off.
row2.p2: Our concierge handles the harbour paperwork, the port fees, and the timing — you simply step on, and step off.

cta.title: Tell us the date, the guests, the route.

header.title:
Quiet, professional,
cleared.
header.sub: Personal protection officers, residential villa security, and secure transport in Mykonos. Vetted, multilingual, ex-military — for celebrity, corporate and diplomatic clientele.

intro.title:
VIP Security &
Secure Transportation.
intro.lead: Some guests arrive on the island already known. Others prefer to leave it that way. MPM provides discreet close protection, residential security and secure transport — a quiet, professional layer between you and everything else.

row1.title: The people you do not notice, until you need them.
row1.body: Our protection officers are ex-military and former government close protection — vetted, NDA-signed, and trained in discreet operations. They speak English, Greek, French and Russian as standard, dress to blend with the setting (plain clothes by default, uniform on request) and operate to a single brief: anticipate, do not react.

bullets: Close protection officers (CPOs) — multilingual, ex-military, background-checked
24-hour villa & perimeter security teams
Secure transport in armoured vehicles on request
Advance reconnaissance of venues, restaurants and beach clubs
NDA-signed · discreet uniform or plain clothes
Cleared for celebrity, corporate and diplomatic clientele · quoted by request

verticals.title:
Four areas, one
operations desk.
verticals.lead: Personal, residential, event and advance — every assignment is run by a single operations lead, with a 24-hour control desk on the island and a direct line to your concierge.

tiles.title: Personal protection
tiles.body: One-to-one or team close protection through the duration of your stay — at the villa, on the way to dinner, inside the club, at the airport. Plain clothes by default, uniformed on request.

tiles.title: Villa & residential
tiles.body: Static guards and patrols at the villa, full perimeter security, CCTV review, and staff vetting. Particularly relevant for guests with public profiles, young families, or high-value assets on site.

tiles.title: Event & wedding security
tiles.body: Guest-list management, discreet door staff, internal patrols, and coordination with venue security. We have run events at every major estate, hotel and beach club on the island.

tiles.title: Advance & reconnaissance
tiles.body: For high-sensitivity visits, our advance team surveys every venue, route and arrival point a week before the guest lands. Risk-assessed, briefed, and rehearsed.

row2.title: Secure vehicles. Trained drivers. Pre-cleared routes.
row2.p1: For sensitive movements we deploy armoured Mercedes-Benz vehicles paired with security-trained chauffeurs. Routes are surveyed in advance, alternates pre-cleared, and a chase vehicle deployed where the brief calls for it. Helicopter transfers from JMK direct to a villa helipad, where available, are arranged through our aviation partner.
row2.p2: Every engagement begins with an off-record conversation with our principal. Pricing is provided after the brief is understood — never before.
